requirements.requirement: The system must include an 'explainability' field in the FastAPI JSON response when the evaluate care endpoint is invoked.
The system must populate the 'explainability' field with the exact structured payload returned by the evaluate_care_facade without mutation.
The system must ensure the explainability payload includes measure_id, raw_value, normalized_score, weight, and contribution_to_final_score for each measure.
The system must update the tool_router response contract to include the explainability field in tool outputs.
The system must ensure the explainability payload is serializable to valid JSON without runtime errors.
The system must preserve backward compatibility by continuing to return existing top-level score fields alongside the new explainability payload.
The system must ensure that the explainability payload is included in responses delivered to both API clients and chat-based tool consumers.
The system must return an empty array for the explainability field when no measures are available rather than omitting the field.
The system must return a 500 error response if the explainability payload cannot be constructed due to facade failure.
The system must return a 200 response with explainability omitted only if the facade explicitly returns null for explainability and logs a warning.
The system must ensure LLM-facing tool responses include explainability in a deterministic and schema-consistent format across repeated calls.
The system must ensure LLM-facing tool responses do not reorder or drop measures within the explainability payload unless explicitly defined by the facade.
The system must ensure LLM-facing tool responses expose numeric fields (raw_value, normalized_score, weight, contribution_to_final_score) as numbers, not strings.
The system must ensure LLM-facing tool responses include all measures used in final score computation without omission.
The system must ensure LLM-facing tool responses maintain consistent key naming exactly as defined in the explainability schema.
The system must ensure LLM-facing tool responses include explainability payload within the same response object as the overall score.
The system must ensure LLM-facing tool responses remain under size limits defined by FastAPI and do not exceed payload constraints due to explainability data.
The system must ensure LLM-facing tool responses do not include any internal-only fields (e.g., debug metadata) within the explainability payload.
